const LAB={minX:-30,maxX:30,minZ:-40,maxZ:14,height:4.4,wallY:2.2};
const labColliders=[];
const labLights=[];
const labFixtureLights=[];

function addLabCollider(x,z,hx,hz,opts={}){labColliders.push({x,z,hx,hz,disabled:false,...opts});}

function fWall(x1,z1,x2,z2,opts={}){
  const h=opts.height??4.4, th=opts.thick??.3, m=opts.material??mat('facility wall',0x4b5049);
  const alongX=Math.abs(z2-z1)<.001;
  const a=alongX?Math.min(x1,x2):Math.min(z1,z2), b=alongX?Math.max(x1,x2):Math.max(z1,z2);
  const doors=(opts.doors||[]).slice().sort((p,q)=>p.at-q.at);
  let cur=a;
  const seg=(s,e)=>{const len=e-s;if(len<.02)return;
    if(alongX) box(lab,'facility wall',(s+e)/2,h/2,z1,len,h,th,m);
    else box(lab,'facility wall',x1,h/2,(s+e)/2,th,h,len,m);
    addLabCollider(alongX?(s+e)/2:x1, alongX?z1:(s+e)/2, alongX?len/2:th/2, alongX?th/2:len/2);
  };
  const header=(s,e,dh)=>{const len=e-s;if(len<.02)return;
    if(alongX) box(lab,'door header',(s+e)/2,(dh+h)/2,z1,len,h-dh,th,m);
    else box(lab,'door header',x1,(dh+h)/2,(s+e)/2,th,h-dh,len,m);
  };
  for(const d of doors){
    const ds=d.at-d.w/2, de=d.at+d.w/2, dh=d.h??2.65;
    seg(cur,ds); header(ds,de,dh);
    // frame
    for(const s of [ds,de]){ ... jamb box ... }
    // top frame
    ...
    if(d.glass){ add glass pane + collider }
    if(d.panel) { two sliding panels }
    cur=de;
  }
  seg(cur,b);
}

```js
const signCache=new Map();
function signMaterial(text, sub=''){
  const key=text+'|'+sub;
  if(signCache.has(key))return signCache.get(key);
  const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=512;c.height=128;
  const g=c.getContext('2d');
  g.fillStyle='#151a17';g.fillRect(0,0,512,128);
  g.strokeStyle='#5d655b';g.lineWidth=4;g.strokeRect(6,6,500,116);
  g.fillStyle='#c9bfa4';g.font='bold 46px monospace';g.textAlign='center';
  g.fillText(text,256,sub?60:78);
  if(sub){g.fillStyle='#7d8a78';g.font='24px monospace';g.fillText(sub,256,100);}
  // scratches
  ...
  const tex=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);tex.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;tex.anisotropy=4;
  const m=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:tex,transparent:true,toneMapped:false});
  signCache.set(key,m);return m;
}
function addSign(text,sub,x,y,z,ry=0,scale=1){
  const w=1.7*scale,h=w*0.25;
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w,h),signMaterial(text,sub));
  mesh.position.set(x,y,z);mesh.rotation.y=ry;lab.add(mesh);return mesh;
}
```

function findPath(sx,sz,tx,tz){
  const w=PATH.w,h=PATH.h;
  const s=idx(sx,sz), t=idx(tx,tz);
  if(s<0||t<0)return null;
  const prev=new Int32Array(w*h).fill(-1);
  const seen=new Uint8Array(w*h); const q=[s]; seen[s]=1;
  let head=0;
  while(head<q.length && !seen[t]){
    const c=q[head++]; const cx=c%w, cz=(c/w)|0;
    for(const [dx,dz] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){
      const nx=cx+dx,nz=cz+dz;if(nx<0||nz<0||nx>=w||nz>=h)continue;
      const ni=nz*w+nx;if(seen[ni]||!PATH.walk[ni])continue;
      seen[ni]=1;prev[ni]=c;q.push(ni);
    }
  }
  if(!seen[t])return null;
  const path=[];let c=t;
  while(c!==s){path.push({x:PATH.x0+(c%w),z:PATH.z0+((c/w)|0)});c=prev[c];if(c<0)return null;}
  path.reverse();return path;
}
